tasks.label: Redesign preview
tasks.command: npx vite --port 1500 --strictPort

tasks.label: Verify redesign
tasks.command: npm run build && npm run test:ui

tasks.label: Verify adaptation
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib plan::pacing::tests --offline -q

tasks.label: Verify adaptive glass UI
tasks.command: npm run build && npx playwright test --grep-invert 'visual matrix (light|dark) (320|390|768)px|daily signal labels'

tasks.label: Verify micro animations
tasks.command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep 'motion system'

tasks.label: Verify glass interaction rewrite
tasks.command: npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep 'all action tones|glass system palette states|touch surfaces track|reduced motion keeps|selection continuity|semantic reveals|frosted surfaces' --workers=1

tasks.label: Verify benchmarks
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib benchmark --offline && npm run build && npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep 'benchmark'

tasks.label: Verify benchmark workflows
tasks.command: npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep benchmark --output test-results-benchmarks

tasks.label: Verify map themes
tasks.command: npx tsc --noEmit && npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep 'map theme overrides|activity route draws' --workers=1 --output=test-results-map-themes

tasks.label: Verify benchmark regressions
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --offline && npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep 'benchmark|schedule mutations|reset previews|plan creation|pacing' --output test-results-benchmark-regressions

tasks.label: Verify race test integration
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --offline -- --skip calendar::tests::quality_sessions_are_named_and_easy_steps_have_no_upper_bound && npm run build && npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep 'benchmark|schedule mutations|reset previews|plan creation|pacing' --output test-results-benchmark-regressions && git diff --check

tasks.label: Verify UI system unification
tasks.command: npm run build && PLAYWRIGHT_JSON_OUTPUT_NAME=test-results/ui-system-report.json npm run test:ui -- --reporter=dot,json --output=test-results/ui-system && git diff --check

tasks.label: Verify training methods
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --offline training_method -- --nocapture

tasks.label: Verify Strava
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --offline strava::tests

tasks.label: Check Strava iOS
tasks.command: cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --target aarch64-apple-ios

tasks.label: Verify Strava UI
tasks.command: npm run build && npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep strava --workers=1 --output=/tmp/runalytics-strava-ui

tasks.label: Verify Strava regressions
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --offline > /tmp/runalytics-strava-rust-regressions.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -45 /tmp/runalytics-strava-rust-regressions.log; exit "$result"

tasks.label: Verify Strava UI regressions
tasks.command: npm run test:ui -- --reporter=dot --output=/tmp/runalytics-strava-full-ui > /tmp/runalytics-strava-full-ui.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -100 /tmp/runalytics-strava-full-ui.log; exit "$result"

tasks.label: Build Strava iOS
tasks.command: npx tauri ios build --debug --no-sign --target aarch64 > /tmp/runalytics-strava-ios-build.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -65 /tmp/runalytics-strava-ios-build.log; exit "$result"

tasks.label: Verify plan freshness
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --offline plan_sync::tests && npm run build && npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep 'plan freshness|native sync completion|calendar settings never publish|plan import only overwrites' --workers=1 --output=/tmp/runalytics-plan-freshness

tasks.label: Verify plan freshness workflows
tasks.command: cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lib --offline plan_sync::tests > /tmp/runalytics-sync-final-rust.log 2>&1 && npm run build > /tmp/runalytics-sync-final-build.log 2>&1 && npx playwright test tests/desk.spec.mjs --grep 'plan freshness|native sync completion|calendar settings never publish|plan import only overwrites|ending a plan requires|benchmark scheduling submits|reset previews|clearing training data' --workers=1 --output=/tmp/runalytics-sync-final-ui > /tmp/runalytics-sync-final-ui.log 2>&1; result=$?; tail -8 /tmp/runalytics-sync-final-rust.log; tail -4 /tmp/runalytics-sync-final-build.log; tail -30 /tmp/runalytics-sync-final-ui.log; exit "$result"
